grammar_focus: Present perfect continuous vs simple; It's the first time I've…; by now, so far, lately
grammar_html:
• zkušenost bez určení času, výsledek dnes
I've been to Norway twice.
s ever, never, already, yet, just
ukončený děj v minulosti s určeným časem
I went to Norway last summer.
s yesterday, last year, in 2019, two weeks ago, when…

Typické vyprávění: otázka v present perfect, podrobnosti v past simple: Have you ever been stranded? – Yes, I was stranded in Oslo in 2022. We slept at the airport.

vocab.ex: We set off at five to avoid the traffic.

vocab.cz: ubytovat se / odhlásit se (v hotelu); odbavit se
vocab.ex: We checked in at the hotel late at night.
On the way to Bali we stopped over in Singapore for two nights.
Our itinerary was so full that we never had time to relax.
We found a lovely village off the beaten track.
We rented a cabin in the mountains to get away from it all.
I've learnt to travel light – just one small backpack.
I always suffer from jet lag after flying east.
We were stranded at the airport for two days because of the snow.
From the top there's a breathtaking view of the whole valley.
The restaurant on the main square is a real tourist trap.
We sat in a café and soaked up the atmosphere of the old town.
It took us a day to get our bearings in Tokyo.
We spent the morning taking in the sights of Lisbon.
When the bus didn't come, we hitched a lift to the next town.
Every hotel in town was fully booked because of the festival.

vocab.cz: cesta, jaká se poštěstí jednou za život
vocab.ipa: ə ˌwʌns ɪn ə ˈlaɪftaɪm trɪp
vocab.ex: Seeing the northern lights was part of a once-in-a-lifetime trip.
I've picked up a few words of Portuguese on this trip.
I experienced real culture shock during my first week in India.
The best way to see Prague is to explore it on foot.
Our train was late, so we missed our connection in Vienna.
I can never sleep on long-haul flights.
After six months at home I always get itchy feet.
She caught the travel bug on a school trip to Italy.
For my job I live out of a suitcase three weeks a month.
This tiny museum is a hidden gem.
We found an unspoilt beach with no hotels at all.
Český Krumlov is one of the most picturesque towns in Europe.
As students we travelled around Asia on a shoestring.
A friend of ours put us up for a week in Berlin.
We got ripped off by a taxi driver at the airport.
Our hotel was a stone's throw from the beach.

exercises.q: There was a heavy snowstorm and no planes could leave for two days. → (a breathtaking view / be stranded / get your bearings / suffer from jet lag)
We visited a quiet village that isn't in any guidebook. → (a breathtaking view / be fully booked / off the beaten track / suffer from jet lag)
The coffee on the main square cost three times the normal price. → (a tourist trap / be fully booked / get your bearings / suffer from jet lag)
On the first day I didn't know where anything was in the city. → (a tourist trap / get your bearings / off the beaten track / travel light)
I only took a small backpack for a two-week trip. → (a breathtaking view / be fully booked / get your bearings / travel light)
After the flight from Tokyo I couldn't sleep at night for a week. → (a tourist trap / be stranded / suffer from jet lag / travel light)
The hotel had no free rooms because of a big concert. → (be fully booked / be stranded / off the beaten track / travel light)
From the top of the hill we could see the whole lake and the mountains. → (a breathtaking view / a tourist trap / be stranded / off the beaten track)
I (have been / went) to Scotland three times, and I'd love to go again.
We (have visited / visited) Rome last spring.
(Have you ever missed / Did you ever miss) a flight?
She (has lost / lost) her passport on the first day of the trip in 2023.
I can't go out tonight – I (haven't packed / didn't pack) my suitcase yet.
When we arrived at the hotel, our room (wasn't / hasn't been) ready.
I _____ (never / try) Indian food, but I'd love to.
How many countries _____ (you / visit) so far?
We _____ (stay) in a tiny guest house when we were in Crete.
_____ (you / book) the tickets yet?
Our plane _____ (land) two hours late yesterday.
We (have been travelling / are travelling) around Spain for two weeks now.
So far we (have visited / have been visiting) four cities.
It's the first time I (have been / am) to Japan.
I'm exhausted – we (have been walking / have walked) since eight o'clock.
I (have known / have been knowing) our guide for years.
Sorry I'm late! (Have you been waiting / Are you waiting) long?
Lately we (have been eating / ate) out a lot because the hotel has no kitchen.
They left at six, so they should be at the airport (by now / so far).
I have never been on a cruise before. (first time)
exercises.a: It's the first time I've been on a cruise. | It is the first time I have been on a cruise.

exercises.q: We started learning Spanish in March. We are still learning it. (been)
exercises.a: We've been learning Spanish since March. | We have been learning Spanish since March.

exercises.q: Up to now we have spent 300 euros. (so far)
exercises.a: So far we've spent 300 euros. | So far we have spent 300 euros. | We've spent 300 euros so far.

exercises.q: It started raining three hours ago and it's still raining. (for)
exercises.a: It's been raining for three hours. | It has been raining for three hours.

exercises.q: I haven't travelled much in the last few months. (lately)
exercises.a: I haven't travelled much lately. | I have not travelled much lately.

exercises.q: I have never flown business class before. (first time)
exercises.a: It's the first time I've flown business class. | It is the first time I have flown business class.

exercises.q: We set _____ at dawn to avoid the heat.
You can check _____ online 24 hours before the flight.
We have to check _____ of the hotel by eleven.
On the way to Australia we stopped _____ in Dubai.
A friend put us _____ for a few nights in Berlin.
We spent the afternoon walking _____ the old town.
I am travelling around Europe for three weeks now.
exercises.a: I have been travelling around Europe for three weeks now. | I've been travelling around Europe for three weeks now.

exercises.q: It's the first time I visit London.
exercises.a: It's the first time I've visited London. | It is the first time I have visited London.

exercises.q: We have been visiting five museums so far.
exercises.a: We have visited five museums so far. | We've visited five museums so far.

exercises.q: I have been knowing her since our trip to Italy.
exercises.a: I have known her since our trip to Italy. | I've known her since our trip to Italy.

exercises.q: We have arrived in Lisbon yesterday.
Lately I travel a lot for work.
exercises.a: Lately I've been travelling a lot for work. | Lately I have been travelling a lot for work.

exercises.q: We (have been driving / are driving) for six hours – let's stop for a coffee.
So far we (have visited / have been visiting) three castles.
It's the first time I (have eaten / eat) sushi in Japan.
I (have known / have been knowing) my travel partner since school.
They set off at seven, so they should be there (by now / lately).
We (went / have been) to Greece last summer.
(Have you ever been / Have you ever went) to Iceland?
The hotel was fully (booked / full) because of the festival.
We found a lovely village off the beaten (track / road).
I always suffer from jet (lag / delay) after long-haul flights.
It took us a day to get our (bearings / ways) in the city.
That restaurant is a real tourist (trap / trip).
We've _____ (travel) around Portugal for two weeks.
exercises.a: been travelling | been traveling | travelled | traveled

exercises.q: It's the first time I've _____ (fly) alone.
We set _____ early in the morning.
We stopped _____ in Singapore on the way to Bali.
I've learnt to travel _____ – just one backpack.
We were _____ at the airport because of the snow.
been / we've / travelling / for / weeks / three
exercises.a: We've been travelling for three weeks.

exercises.q: first / it's / the / time / I've / been / here
exercises.a: It's the first time I've been here.

exercises.q: we've / spent / euros / two / hundred
